title: yanglabkit
msg: A set of AI-agent skills tailored to the Yang Lab's research workflows. It currently includes yanglabkit-scicolor (recommends colour-blind-safe, perceptually uniform palettes for a figure, chart, or map) and yanglabkit-figures (styles matplotlib/seaborn figures print-first, the Yang Lab way). Built on the portable SKILL.md convention, so it works with any AI agent that supports it.
